dish: Stuffed French toast, baked oatmeal and giant cinnamon rolls from the scratch bakery
w: Tiny scratch kitchen on Chocolate Avenue voted Central Pennsylvania's best breakfast by Harrisburg Magazine readers for some two decades running; no reservations, so lines form early.

dish: Sundaes and hand-dipped ice cream at Mount Gretna's 1895 parlor
w: Mount Gretna's seasonal ice-cream parlor, a Chautauqua tradition since 1895; its spring opening day is local news.

dish: Hand-twisted Bavarian-style soft pretzels, plus seasoned 'Revolutionary Pretzels' hard pieces
w: Community-founded (2014) small-batch pretzel bakery on West Market Street in downtown York; it has since bought the Intercourse Pretzel Factory in Lancaster County.

dish: Troegenator Double Bock, Perpetual IPA and the cult holiday Mad Elf, on tap where they're brewed
w: The Trogner brothers' brewery, moved from Harrisburg to a 90,000-sq-ft Hershey plant in 2011; its one-hour tour (with tastings) was voted the No. 1 brewery tour in America by USA Today readers. Big tasting room and beer garden with a full view of the brewhouse.
